preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 100,000.
All characters in the string s are lowercase letters of the Latin alphabet.

postconditions.description: The output string t contains the same set of characters as the input string s.

postconditions.expression: all(s.count(c) == t.count(c) for c in set(s))
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string t appears the same number of times as in the input string s.

postconditions.expression: palindromic_count(t) >= palindromic_count(u) for u in permutations(s)
postconditions.description: The palindromic count of the output string t is greater than or equal to the palindromic count of any permutation of the input string s.
